state_coordinates.meaning: The Pluecker brackets are computed with respect to the declared dimensionless area form dx wedge dy.

fit_model.selection_note: One model is fixed for every source slot. No model is selected using the Pluecker residual.

standard_uncertainty_priority: reported expanded uncertainty divided by 2 when a 95 percent confidence level is declared or implied
otherwise reported expanded uncertainty divided by 2 as a conservative provisional conversion
uncertainty_model.coefficient_covariance: inverse normal matrix multiplied by max(1, weighted reduced chi-square)
uncertainty_model.cross_slot_covariance: zero because all twelve source slots use distinct publications
uncertainty_model.bracket_covariance: first-order delta method from the two independent 2x2 gradient covariance matrices
uncertainty_model.plucker_covariance: first-order delta method on the six independent bracket estimates

claim_boundary: A rejection means at least one frozen assumption fails: two-dimensional smooth chart, channel identity, source compatibility, fit contract, uncertainty model, or the Pluecker constraint. It does not by itself identify the failed assumption.
